H-MACRO-CPI-001.name: CPI Downside Surprise Liquidity Impulse
H-MACRO-CPI-001.observation: CPI downside print accelerates risk-on expansion in crypto
H-MACRO-CPI-001.mechanism: Lower inflation print -> Yields down -> DXY down -> Global crypto liquidity expansion
H-MACRO-CPI-001.expected_effect: Increases bull continuation win rate to >= 60%

H-FLOW-ETF-001.name: Institutional ETF Daily Inflow Momentum

H-FLOW-ETF-001.mechanism: Physical spot purchasing absorbs exchange order book depth
H-FLOW-ETF-001.expected_effect: Reduces pullback depth, expands target R to >= 5.0R

H-POS-SQUEEZE-001.name: Crowded Short Negative Funding Squeeze

H-POS-SQUEEZE-001.mechanism: Shorts forced to cover into thin offer side
H-POS-SQUEEZE-001.expected_effect: Sharply lowers time-to-target and boosts win rate
